title-group.article-title: A reconciled harvest of Europe PMC preprint full text

license.license-p: This article is made available under a CC BY 4.0 International license.

abstract.p: We describe a per-identifier REST harvest of Europe PMC preprint full text after the bulk feed was discontinued, and a JATS extractor reconciled to the shared article schema.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Europe PMC previously distributed preprint full text as gzipped range archives on the EBI FTP server. That bulk feed was retired in September 2026, leaving only a compressed list of preprint identifiers. Each preprint's full text must now be fetched individually from the Europe PMC REST service by its PPR identifier. This paragraph exists purely to give the fixture a body substantially longer than three hundred characters so that the extractor classifies the resulting row as an ok extraction rather than an empty one.
The extractor parses the JATS body, the permissions block, the contributor list and the bibliographic identifiers, then emits a single unified article row per preprint file.
